name: status
sql: select s.condition, s.since, s.owed_kind, c.stale_after, c.label, c.dry_run, j.schedule, j.active from publish_watch.state s, publish_watch.config c, cron.job j where j.jobname = 'ten347_publish_watch'

name: last_checks
sql: select id, fired_at, status_code, built_at, commit_sha, cache_age_s, error from publish_watch.checks order by fired_at desc limit 5

name: messages
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at, text from publish_watch.messages order by id

name: neighbours
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by jobname

name: cron_runs
sql: select d.status, d.return_message, d.start_time from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname = 'ten347_publish_watch' order by d.start_time desc limit 10
